summary: Wall Street is ending the week on a strong note, with the Dow up around 500 points and tech rebounding as the OpenAI revenue scare that hammered AI names yesterday fades. Microsoft is flirting with a $4 trillion market cap as confidence in Azure and AI returns comes back.
market_note: VIX down 3.6% as calm returns; bonds closed Monday for Columbus Day while stocks trade normally.

items.why: Bouncing back with the broader tech recovery. Analysts reaffirmed Buy ratings this week, including a $385 target from Tigress, on AWS momentum and the OpenAI cloud partnership.
Closing in on a $4 trillion market cap for the first time in nearly a year, per MarketWatch, as investors re-embrace Azure growth and rising returns on AI spending.
Caught in the continuing chip selloff after the Financial Times reported OpenAI revenue came in $20 billion below what was signaled, weighing on AI-linked semiconductors.
Fear gauge sliding as stocks surge and the Dow adds about 500 points. No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
